note: Scripture source: the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, CC BY-SA 4.0), fetched as USX from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx), all 66 books. Every mined span was sliced from that text by script, never typed. Murray's Roman-numeral citations (1 Pet. i. 15, 16) are rendered with Western digits (1 पतरस 1:15, 16); bare chapter references without a verse (Ps. xcix., Rom. vii.) are mostly written as words (निन्यानबेवाँ भजन, रोमियों का सातवाँ अध्याय).
Translated from the English as the fixture carries it, which already includes this slug's BODY_CORRECTIONS (the restored ch10 cross-references).

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the measurement confirms it (a 6+ character quoted segment of that block, or an 8+ character phrase in the chapter, is a byte substring of the cited IRV verse). adapted/self rows and 7 unconfirmed verbatim claims (2 Tim 1:9 ch02, 2 Cor 4:6 ch13, Phil 2:7 ch14, Eph 3:19 and 3:8 ch15, Acts 4:27 and John 14:6 ch17) are self_rendered. Unquoted echoes are not recorded. 373 mined, 254 self_rendered.

Murray's refrain 'Be ye holy, as I am holy' (the close of most days) is rendered पवित्र बनो, जैसा मैं पवित्र हूँ, mirroring his 'as' (an echo of 1 Pet 1:15 'as he which hath called you is holy'); where the English quotes 'for I am holy' the IRV 1 Pet 1:16 text पवित्र बनो, क्योंकि मैं पवित्र हूँ is used. The 'as' rows are recorded adapted, not mined.

Citations corrected in the Hindi (the English cites the wrong verse for the words it quotes): ch02 and ch17 '2 Thess. ii. 12' → 2:13; ch08 'xxii 21, 33' → 22:31-33; ch16 '1 Cor. iii. 14' → 3:16; ch26 '1 Thess. iii. 15' → 3:13 (and 'Eph. i. 4, 5, 27' read as 1:4; 5:27); ch32 'Rom. xvi. 3' → 16:2; ch33 Bengel's 'v. 14' is 'verse 14' (Heb 12:14). Kept as printed (arguably a passage reference): ch24 '1 Cor. iii. 16' for 3:17, '1 John ii. 15' introducing 2:16; ch06 'Num. iii. 13, viii. 17'.

KJV/IRV divergences an editor should see (IRV kept inside quotation marks; Murray's point carried in his own sentences): Col 4:12 IRV 'पूर्ण विश्वास के साथ' with no 'all' where Murray argues from 'in all the will of God' (ch20, ch27 — 'all' sits outside the quote marks); 2 Pet 3:11 no 'all' (ch32, likewise); Rev 22:11 IRV 'पवित्र बना रहे' loses 'be made yet more holy' (ch32, self-rendered); Isa 57:15 हर्षित ('gladden') for 'revive' (ch14); Isa 29:19 no 'increase' (ch22); Acts 3:14 तिरस्कार where Murray's contrast needs 'denied' (ch18); 1 John 2:20 'सत्य जानते हो' for 'know all things' (ch31); 1 Thess 4:3 a verb (पवित्र बनो) for 'sanctification' (ch27); 1 Tim 4:5 शुद्ध for 'sanctified' (ch24); Exod 8:1 उपासना for 'serve' (ch21, ch28); Exod 19:5 has no 'voice' — ch08 blocks 8 and 11 insert वाणी (self-rendered); John 7:39 IRV 'आत्मा' without 'Holy' (ch16 epigraph kept pure IRV); John 17:17 'सत्य के द्वारा' for 'in the truth' (ch17); Titus 2:14 no 'possession' (ch33 uses the IRV's निज प्रजा from 1 Pet 2:9); Heb 9:8 and 10:19 use पवित्रस्थान, the IRV's word also for the outer holy place, while Murray's prose distinguishes परमपवित्र स्थान / पवित्र स्थान (ch29); Ex 15:11 पवित्रता के कारण महाप्रतापी — ch07 block 8 adds a bridging gloss अर्थात् पवित्रता में महिमामय (editor may strike).

Conventions: single curly quotation marks mirror the English per chapter (the English's own ‘ ’; “ ” only in the Notes); Christ referred to in the singular (वह/उसका, IRV style); the reader addressed as तुम, God in prayer as तू; holy पवित्र, holiness/sanctification पवित्रता, the Holiest परमपवित्र स्थान, the Holy One (of Israel) as the IRV has it; परमेश्वर without a zero-width joiner. Each chapter keeps the source's closing <h3> naming the NEXT day (दूसरा दिन। … इकतीसवाँ दिन।) — an artefact of the English import, mirrored. Chapter titles pinned across all translators; ch31 renders Murray's Christos/'christed' wordplay with ख्रीष्ट / ख्रीष्ट-अभिषेक.

ENGLISH SOURCE items NOT repaired (the Hindi renders the evident sense): ch30 '0 ye chastened saints' (digit zero for 'O'); ch09 'master‘s' (opening quote used as an apostrophe — the Hindi has one ‘ fewer than the English); ch13 block 17 a missing colon; ch16 'It it universally admitted'; ch17 'the truth or thought and sentiment' (for 'of'); ch03 block 16 and ch20 stray capitals on He/Him for a believer and for Paul; ch33 'Stockmaiev' (Stockmayer) and Schmieder's 'union and interpretation' (read as interpenetration); every chapter's trailing next-day heading.
